title: 第一卷 第6113章 融合吞天王座第一卷 第6112章 序列之王的耻辱
content_zh:
今日一战，叶寒几乎知晓了序列之王的战力上限。
说实话，要让他现在镇杀一尊序列之王？
除非动用永镇天疆四大字印，否则没有任何希望！
道与法的绝对压制面前，一切都是虚的。
再强大的力量、神念爆发，都难以弥补这种差距。
刚才，看似自己大胜，两个序列之王都在吐血，但叶寒很清楚，他们那是轻伤。
两大序列之王，甚至包括那个裂空少主，他们都擅长怎样的手段，拥有哪几种规则大道神通，一概不知。
若非他们对自己极其陌生，亦根本想象不到一尊混沌主宰能够爆发出那样的力量与神念，自己占了出其不意的优势，今日这一战不会就此落幕。
下一次，可就不一样了。
但是……
叶寒此刻已经推演出来了。
这吞天王座的力量，无比强横，其中蕴藏着一种堪称至高无上、不可想象的伟力。
有着超越终焉之主级别的强者留下的印记、力量。
掌控了吞天王座，自己镇杀一尊序列之王，理应不成问题。
那也算拥有了在葬神之地自保的底气。
“不过，我能得到吞天王座，难保这种序列之王，不会得到其他类似的东西。”
叶寒脑海中，这般念头涌动。
葬神之地的诸多逆天之物，不止一两件。
类似吞天王座的东西，也不是一两种。
按照赵怡三人的说法，亦有古老的天碑，类似时空天碑一样的东西。

或许没有时空天碑那么逆天，但融合掌控之后，比肩吞天王座是很有可能的。
叶寒一边回味着刚才的一战，推演着关于几尊序列之王，包括类似裂空少主那样的半步序列之王的一切，一边盘坐在此，开始融合吞天王座。
类似吞天王座也好，包括第七层诸天未来诞生的真神大位，以及那最为恐怖的时空天碑。
这些无敌的至宝，都是不可能被轻易炼化的。
就算强行将自己的印记打入其中，融入内部，都不能算是真正炼化。
这种最顶级的宝物，只能够进行融合。
融合成功，类似一种另类的炼化，等同于将之变成自己身躯的一部分。
那也能够得到相应的力量加持，催动至宝之中可怕的力量。
诸般念头变化间……
不知不觉，一个时辰过去。
叶寒彻底进入了这种沉寂状态中。
content_en:
In today's battle, Ye Han almost knew the upper limit of the Sequence King's combat power.
To be honest, do you want him to kill a sequence king now?
Unless the four seals of Yongzhen Tianjiang are used, there is no hope!
In the face of the absolute suppression of Tao and Dharma, everything is empty.
No matter how powerful the power or spiritual power is, it is difficult to make up for this gap.
Just now, it seemed that he had won a great victory. Both sequence kings were vomiting blood, but Ye Han knew very well that their injuries were minor.
The two kings of the sequence, and even the Young Master Splitting the Sky, have no idea what methods they are good at and what kinds of rules and magical powers they possess.
If they had not been extremely unfamiliar with themselves, and would never have imagined that a Chaos Lord could burst out with such power and divine will, and they had an unexpected advantage, today's battle would not have ended here.
Next time, it will be different.
But...
Ye Han had already deduced it at this moment.
The power of this swallowing throne is extremely powerful, and it contains a kind of supreme and unimaginable power.
It has the mark and power left by a strong person who surpasses the level of the Lord of the End.
After taking control of the Heaven-Swallowing Throne, it shouldn't be a problem to kill a sequence king by myself.
That can be regarded as having the confidence to protect oneself in the God Burial Land.
"However, I can get the Heaven-Swallowing Throne. There is no guarantee that the king of this sequence will not get other similar things."
Such thoughts surged in Ye Han's mind.
There are more than one or two unnatural things in the God Burial Land.
There are not just one or two things similar to the Heaven-Swallowing Throne.
According to Zhao Yi and the others, there is also an ancient sky stele, something similar to the time and space stele.
It may not be as heaven-defying as the Time and Space Sky Monument, but after fusion and control, it is very possible to be as good as the Heaven-Swallowing Throne.
Ye Han was recalling the battle just now and deducing everything about several sequence kings, including half-step sequence kings like Young Master Splitting the Sky, while sitting here cross-legged and starting to fuse the Heaven-Swallowing Throne.
It is similar to the Heaven-Swallowing Throne, including the throne of the True God that will be born in the future of the seventh-level heavens, and the most terrifying space-time monument.
These invincible treasures cannot be easily refined.
Even if you force your own mark into it and integrate it inside, it cannot be regarded as true refining.
This top-notch treasure can only be fused.
Successful fusion is like a different kind of refining, which is equivalent to turning it into a part of one's own body.
That can also be blessed with corresponding power and activate the terrifying power in the treasure.
As thoughts change...
Before I knew it, an hour passed.
Ye Han completely entered this state of silence.
